agent.dyna_q module

Dyna-Q reinforcement learning agent implementation.

Implements the tabular Dyna-Q architecture combining direct Q-learning, transition model learning, simulated planning sampling, modular exploration policies, and learning rate scheduling (Sutton & Barto 1998; Feldmaier & Diepold 2014).

agent.planning module

Dyna model learning and simulated planning memory.

Stores environment transition dynamics experienced by the agent and performs planning updates via random sampling of previously experienced state-action pairs.

class agent.planning.DynaModel

Bases: object

Deterministic environment transition model for Dyna-Q planning.

transitions

Mapping from (state, action) -> (reward, next_state).

Type:

Dict[Tuple[int, int], Tuple[float, int]]

visited_states

List of states previously encountered.

Type:

List[int]

actions_taken

Set of actions taken in each visited state.

Type:

Dict[int, Set[int]]

plan(q_table: QTable, planning_steps: int, alpha: float, gamma: float, rng: Random | None = None) → None

Execute Dyna-Q planning updates using simulated experience.

Randomly samples previously visited (state, action) pairs from memory and applies Q-learning update (Eq. 1).

Parameters:

  • q_table (QTable) – The agent’s Q-table to update.

  • planning_steps (int) – Number of simulated transitions to replay (p_steps).

  • alpha (float) – Step-size / learning rate.

  • gamma (float) – Discount rate.

  • rng (Optional[random.Random], optional) – Random number generator.

reset() → None

Clear all stored transitions and model history.

update(state: int, action: int, reward: float, next_state: int) → None

Record an observed environment transition.

Parameters:

  • state (int) – Origin state index.

  • action (int) – Executed action index.

  • reward (float) – Observed reward.

  • next_state (int) – Resulting state index.
